tour.title: PM-Buddy clickable prototype
tour.intro: Every screen uses realistic mock data for a Kenyan contractor with two projects. Nothing is saved or sent. Use it to review the look and feel, layout and key workflows before we build the real thing in Phase 1.

signIn.title: Sign-in and MFA
signIn.description: Email or phone sign-in, phone normalisation to 2547…, then a TOTP step with passkey and SMS fallbacks.

dashboard.title: Owner dashboard
dashboard.description: Cash, spend, labour on site and approvals; projects with CPI/SPI; alerts; spend and cash-flow charts; sites map.

project.title: Project overview
project.description: Ruiru Heights: S-curve, budget vs earned vs actual by bill, milestones, geofenced site and activity.

bq.title: Bill of Quantities
bq.description: Bill → Section → Item tree with progress, totals, VAT, original vs revised contract sum and variation orders.

bqImport.title: BQ import mapping
bqImport.description: Five-step Excel import: sheet and header detection, column mapping, hierarchy rules and totals reconciliation.

labour.title: Labour registry
labour.description: Saved views, bulk actions, masked IDs and phones, worker side panel, under-18 registration block.

attendance.title: Attendance and anomalies
attendance.description: Today’s muster roll by capture method, plus the anomaly queue: impossible travel, geofence, clock drift, overrides.

payroll.title: Payroll approval and M-Pesa payout
payroll.description: Maker-checker steps, float check, step-up MFA, then a simulated bulk B2C payout with a failure and a name mismatch.

portal.title: Client portal
portal.description: For a diaspora client: progress, verified photos, variation approval, FX display and STK Push payment.

site.title: Site app (Android)
site.description: Web mock-ups of the offline-first site app: face kiosk, foreman’s offline muster roll and sync status.

review.look: Look and feel: neutral base with a royal blue accent, typography and spacing.
review.density: Office density: tables, filters, side panels and keyboard search (⌘K / Ctrl+K).
review.language: Switch EN ↔ SW (top right): every label, status and message should change.
review.dark: Light and dark mode, and readability of status colours in both.
review.mobile: Mobile layouts: client portal and site app (large touch targets, high contrast).
review.trust: Trust signals: verified photos, masked personal data, maker-checker and MFA on money.

bqImport.title: Import BQ from Excel
bqImport.description: QS formats vary, so you map the columns once and save the mapping as a template.

help.upload: Upload the QS’s .xlsx file. It is scanned and stored privately.
help.sheet: Choose which sheets to import and confirm the header row.
help.map: Tell PM-Buddy which column holds each field. Detected rows are shown below.
help.hierarchy: Rules that turn rows into Bill → Section → Item.
help.validate: Every bill total is recomputed from quantity × rate and compared with the sheet.

rules.xlsxOnly: .xlsx files only. The size limit is configurable.
rules.private: Files are stored in a private bucket and opened with short-lived links.

bqImport.templateName: “Mwangi & Associates QS format”, last used on Kitengela Bungalow

hierarchy.bill: Rows starting with “BILL NO.” start a new bill
hierarchy.section: Rows in CAPITALS without a quantity are section headings
hierarchy.collection: “Carried to Collection” and summary rows are subtotals: checked, not imported
hierarchy.lumpSum: Items with unit Sum or Item and no quantity are lump, provisional or PC sums

bqImport.mismatchDetail: Bill 2, row 23 (concrete in ground beams): the sheet says {sheet} but quantity × rate is {computed}. This looks like a typing error.

resolution.sheet: Keep the amount typed in the sheet
resolution.flag: Ask the QS to confirm before importing

bqImport.importedToast: Prototype: version {version} would be created as a draft for QS approval (D2.2).

labour.title: Labour
labour.description: Registered workers, gangs and today’s status
labour.search: Search by name or worker number

register.title: Register a worker
register.description: Step 1 of 3: personal details. Consent and the card or biometric enrolment come next.
register.name: Full name (as on ID)
register.underage: Registration blocked: this person is {age}. Workers must be 18 or older.
register.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Kenyan mobile number.
register.rateHint: The project default for this trade is used if left blank.
register.encryptionNote: ID numbers, phone numbers and KRA PINs are encrypted. Only managers can reveal them, and every reveal is logged.
register.savedToast: Prototype: the next step would capture consent (D3.1).

detail.revealToast: Access recorded in the audit log.
detail.thresholdWarning: Continuously engaged for {days} days. Review casual-to-term conversion (the threshold is configurable and needs legal review).
detail.consentNote: Consent was recorded in Kiswahili and read aloud with a witness. Workers can withdraw at any time without penalty.
detail.dnrToast: Prototype: a reason would be required and the change audited.
detail.dnrNote: Requires a written reason. Only managers can see it.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Today’s muster roll. Check-ins after {lateAfter} count as late. Anomalies need a decision.

details.impossible_travel: Checked in at {siteA} at {timeA} and at {siteB} at {timeB}: {km} km apart in {minutes} minutes.
details.outside_geofence: Checked in {distance} m outside the site (GPS accuracy ±{accuracy} m) on {device}.
details.clock_drift: Device {device} was {minutes} minutes behind server time. {events} events were adjusted and flagged.
details.duplicate: Two check-ins at {first} and {second}. The first was kept.
details.low_confidence: Face match {score} was below the {threshold} threshold. Confirmed with the worker card by a supervisor.

attendance.acceptedToast: Anomaly accepted and recorded in the audit log.
attendance.rejectedToast: Anomaly rejected. The record is excluded from the timesheet.

payroll.title: Payroll {batch}
payroll.summaryDescription: {workers} workers · payout by M-Pesa B2C (salary payment)
payroll.illustrative: Deductions are illustrative only. The statutory engine (PAYE, NSSF, SHIF, Housing Levy) arrives in D4.1 and uses versioned, effective-dated rules that need compliance review.

checks.float: M-Pesa float {float} covers the payout and charges
checks.makerChecker: Prepared, reviewed and approved by different people

payroll.returnedToast: Prototype: the batch would go back to finance with your comment.
payroll.doneToast: Payout finished: 1 failed and 1 name mismatch need review.
payroll.failedTitle: {count, plural, one {# payment failed} other {# payments failed}}
payroll.failedDetail: A transaction status check confirmed nothing was sent. It is safe to retry after the worker’s number is corrected.
payroll.mismatchTitle: {count, plural, one {# name mismatch} other {# name mismatches}}
payroll.mismatchDetail: The name M-Pesa returned doesn’t match the registered worker. Future payouts to this number are on hold until a manager reviews it.
payroll.stepUpNote: This approval is tied to this batch and amount. A code for one approval can’t be reused for another.
payroll.approvedToast: Approved. Payments are queued and confirmed only when M-Pesa replies.
